question: Hello Odacchi! In chapter 931, Sanji says that Soba Mask's ability to become invisible is the power of the raid suit. Does that mean it is the power of the raid suit that allows Reiju to create and manipulate poison? If I were to be poisoned, would Reiju be able to save me if she wasn't wearing her raid suit?
answer: Em. First of all, the ability is the power of the suit, but since Judge systematically started by creating a human body suitable for each "ability", Reiju is a person who is somewhat resistant to poison. If it's just sucking poison out of someone, she can do that without her raid suit. The rest depends on whether or not Reiju wants to save you. (laugh)
name: Nine
